service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USE_NUMBER , SUBJECT , CONTENT , SORT_SEQ , CASE CORP_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS CORP_FLAG , CASE USE_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS USE_FLAG , CASE EXTERNAL_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS EXTERNAL_FLAG , FORM_ID , YD_NUMBER FROM SUDGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

SELECT SUBJECT , CONTENT , SORT_SEQ , CORP_FLAG , USE_FLAG , EXTERNAL_FLAG FROM SUDGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND YD_NUMBER = ${YD_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N'

SELECT APUD.HOUSE_CODE ,APUD.COMPANY_CODE ,APUD.APP_USER_ID ,APUD.APP_USER_DEPT ,APUD.APP_SORT ,APUD.CHANGE_FLAG ,APUD.DEL_FLAG ,USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_NAME ,DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_DEPT_NAME FROM SAPUD APUD INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = APUD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = APUD.APP_USER_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = APUD.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = APUD.APP_USER_DEPT WHERE APUD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND APUD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND APUD.KEY_NUMBER = ${KEY_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(APUD.CHANGE_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(APUD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
